::: {#sol-relu-grad}

Entry $h_k = \maxf{0, z_{1k}}$ depends only on $z_{1k}$,
with derivative 1 where $z_{1k} > 0$ and 0 where $z_{1k} < 0$,
as in [the slopes of the activation functions](feedforward-networks.qmd#sol-activation-slopes).
So

$$
\derivf{L}{z_{1k}} = \derivf{L}{h_k} \, \indicf{z_{1k} > 0}:
$$

the gradient passes through each unit that was positive and stops at each unit that was 0.

:::
